name: BT Catalog
changelog: Fixes missing product photos (Shaka Wear and any other brand affected). Colour photo, swatch and hex were only ever read from the FIRST SKU returned for each colourway, and S&S leaves those fields blank on some size rows — so whole brands imported with prices and colour counts intact but no images at all. Each field now fills from the first SKU that actually carries it, and a style with no flat-lay photo falls back through the on-model and side/back angles instead of rendering 'No image'. The S&S probe now reports how many colourways have a photo and samples one that does. Updating queues an automatic catalog refresh, so affected styles repair themselves.
